{{Top}}
[[File:Geonosis_AotC.png|thumb|right|200px|[[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] had a planetary ring.]]
A '''planetary ring''' was a group of debris, dust, [[Water/Legends|ice]], hardened [[Magma/Legends|magma]] or other matter that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. During the rule of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], several worlds that were part of that government sported planetary rings. Planetary rings could also be created artificially, with [[Rings of Coruscant|the Bridge]] being a [[Yuuzhan Vong]]&mdash;created planetary ring around [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
